Attention.title: Attention
Attention.body:
Pendenzen shows what waits for you: bank bookings, other proposals and work to do. The chips at the top filter by section.

Each row names the counterparty, the booking text, the account, the date and the amount. A small star before the account means a booking rule books it. A click opens one line beneath where you change the text, the account and the VAT code. The star on the right saves the booking as a rule; the speech bubble adds a comment for the agent.

Keys: arrow up and down move between rows, Enter opens one, F approves, R rejects. After an approval the message briefly offers Undo.
